I can't confirm a `just` recipe for this. The checkout I'm looking at still has the `Makefile` and has no `justfile`, so the removal may be on another branch or not committed yet.

The fast tests are the unit suite without the Postgres tests. The underlying command is:

```
pytest -m "not postgres" -q
```

That's what `make test-fast` runs here. If your `justfile` has a matching recipe, it's probably `just test-fast`, but I haven't seen it, so check with `just --list`. If it only has `test`, you can add a recipe like this:

```just
test-fast:
    pytest -m "not postgres" -q
```

The full suite (`make test`, or `just test` in your setup) runs everything. According to a stored project note, it needs `docker compose up db` first.

That note still says `make test-fast`. I haven't changed it, because the repo doesn't show the Makefile being removed. Once the `justfile` lands, I can update the note to the new command.
